answer: Agents bind identity to a Verkle commitment whose polynomial evaluation key is derived from a scarce on-chain pigment deposit, making each Sybil node costly to clone across the meadow of peers. Stateless validators prune archival state to a karst-like sparse witness set, so forged identities cannot amortize proof bandwidth and colluders are detected via mismatched. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
